description:
[Trading Data API] US Treasury yield curve (1M–30Y) + recession-indicator spreads (10y-2y, 10y-3m), from FRED.

**Example:** `/v1/rates`

Use when you need the US Treasury yield curve and recession spreads (10y-2y, 10y-3m). Not for event dates (use macro_calendar).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

series.description: Optional. A specific FRED series id (e.g. DGS10) for a single value.

name: rates
